Description: A dependency-driven mobile automation platform that provisions social media accounts by orchestrating multi-stage workflows across applications on real Android devices.
Workflow Engine: User-configurable execution paths via centralized dashboard
Dependency Logic: If Gmail credentials are provided -> skip Gmail creation -> proceed to Instagram
If not provided -> create Gmail -> reuse credentials for Instagram
Execution path determined via dashboard configuration
Cross-Application Orchestration: Seamless context switching between Gmail and Instagram applications
Real-time OTP retrieval from Gmail during Instagram verification
Credential propagation across applications within a single session
Data Handling: Persistent storage in local files and centralized system
Separate logging for partial and complete workflow states
Automation Engine: Dynamic UI detection with multi-layer fallback strategies
Retry logic for Instagram failures using existing Gmail credentials
Crash detection with controlled session completion
Failure Handling: Invalidation of failed Gmail inputs (e.g., verification failure)
Retry mechanism for Instagram without re-provisioning Gmail
Session termination after repeated unrecoverable failures
Recovery handling for delayed OTP and app lifecycle interruptions
Performance Metrics: Average execution time: 5–6 minutes per full cycle
Success rate aligned with Gmail provisioning system
Challenges: Handling delayed OTP delivery and app lifecycle interruptions
Maintaining workflow continuity after unexpected restarts
Ensuring stable session management across multi-stage execution
Testing: Verification of partial and complete execution states
